name: worker-preclaim-qualification
goal: Leave tasks queued when provider isolation is unqualified and retain the launch-time qualification check.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: An unqualified default worker can claim and mark a task failed before its launcher rejects; it should reject without changing the task ref and should still recheck qualification at launch.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing aborted-preclaim and context-failure worker case checks cancellation but never tests default runner qualification before claiming; extend that same class-method case to assert an unchanged queue and zero context calls.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test-only 56f4737569; guarded clean-snapshot run on harbor-mbp-2 recorded failing assertion instead of rejecting, proof da800b9424a834af6a31c60051da64bbc7e4f1ac37811c3630e474653b56ba5e.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: At 36075e5b14 the worker awaits trusted runner readiness before owner lookup and task claim; the launch adapter still rechecks qualification before sandbox preparation or provider execution.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged focused case passed on harbor-mbp-2 at 36075e5b14 under the same sanitized runtime and environment; green proof 1eb920eae22150b32c9774c062daa7e70e5091f54f8450312d5040570114228b, red proof da800b9424a834af6a31c60051da64bbc7e4f1ac37811c3630e474653b56ba5e.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
